title: Methylation and Aging: Tips to Slow Biological Aging | GeneusDNA.com
abstract:
Some people look and feel vibrant well into their 60s and 70s, while others face chronic fatigue, cognitive decline, and health issues in their 40s. What explains the difference? A big part of the answer lies in biological age—and more specifically, in DNA methylation. Methylation is a key epigenetic process that not only regulates gene activity but also serves as a biological clock.
